_comment: Manual provision overrides for bills where LLM auto-extraction needs correction.
_format: bill_id → {description, policies: [...], coverage ('full' | 'partial', default full), override_reason, mapped_by, mapped_date}

hr-7024-118.description: Tax Relief for American Families and Workers Act of 2024

policies.provision_text: Expands Child Tax Credit and restores bonus depreciation and R&D expensing

hr-7024-118.override_reason: Confirmed against CBO score of -$33.5B; CTC expansion + R&D/depreciation provisions

policies.provision_text: Extends the individual TCJA provisions permanently

hr-1-119.override_reason: Maps only the TCJA extension. The law's other tax changes and its spending cuts (Medicaid, SNAP and others) are not mapped, so the calculator reading is partial and low confidence. The earlier mapping's corporate rate cut (21% to 20%) is not in the law and was removed on 2026-11-17.
